headline: Vulcan Materials (NYSE:VMC) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
summary: Construction materials company Vulcan Materials (NYSE:VMC) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 2.5% year on year to $2.16 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.59 per share was 4.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
